## Checklist

- [ ] `model.json` has `name`, `author`, `license`, `tree`, and `source` when the licence is CC BY or CC BY-SA.
- [ ] `license` is `CC0-1.0`, `CC-BY-4.0` or `CC-BY-SA-4.0`.
- [ ] Every file in the folder is my own work or under a licence that allows passing it on as a file.
- [ ] No file comes from an Asset Store pack, Fab, Quixel or Megascans, and none is CC BY-ND or CC BY-NC.
- [ ] `preview.png` shows the tree; pictures are at most 2048 px.
